label: Suicide rate
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = WHO Mortality Database cause-of-death registrations as submitted by member states (civil registration, ICD-coded, intentional self-harm = X60-Y84 and predecessors), redistributed by the OECD Causes of Mortality dataflow over SDMX, 46 countries, 1960-2024, sex-split as published, zero null observations in the live slice; witness tier = WHO Global Health Estimates crude suicide rates via GHO (modeled, 185 countries, 2000-2021, sex-split, uncertainty intervals published but not carried). Authenticity first per ADR-0008: collector as-reported beside model estimates, never blended.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): OECD DF_COM = OECD Terms and Conditions, attribution required (content: WHO Mortality Database); GHO witness = CC-BY-3.0-IGO.
notes: THE SEVENTH INDICATOR, THE CORPUS'S #2 (80 citations across 11 books): suicide is the founding metric of Le Fou et le Prolétaire (38 citations: France 1835-1977, the European table, the class breakdowns) and the second pillar of La Chute finale's Soviet collapse diagnosis (15 citations, the 7-country comparative table). The config is the homicide architecture one cause-code away — canonical WHO-MDB-as-submitted via OECD DF_COM (CICDHARM), witness GHE-modeled via GHO — with one NEW display case the homicide pair does not carry: the two tiers DIVERGE SYSTEMATICALLY, not episodically. GHE re-distributes the "ill-defined causes" (R-codes, the half-certified deaths of every struggling registration system) across the definite causes: Russia male 2000 prints 69.8 as-reported vs 95.2 modeled (both verified live 2026-09-19) — a +36% uplift that IS the reclassification-sensitivity of the metric, displayed tier-by-tier instead of reconciled. reclassification_sensitive=true is literal here: the suicide/accident/undetermined-intent boundary moves with certification quality, and the witness gap measures how much it moved. SEX SPLIT IS TODD-RELEVANT SIGNAL, twice over: the dataflow publishes per sex (Russia 1994: male 73.9 vs female 13.2, a 5.6x ratio as-reported — the Leskov/Werther asymmetry the books lean on), and the witness carries the split too (95.2 vs 16.0 modeled the same year). HONEST SCOPE LIMITS: 46 countries canonical (OECD members + key partners — most of Africa and Central Asia absent, Ukraine and Belarus absent from this dataflow, Russia ends 2019 per the WHO MDB lag — 2020+ is witness-only there); the witness's window is 2000-2021 only, so pre-2000 and post-2021 comparisons are canonical-only; France's historical series (1835-1977, the Fou et le Prolétaire backbone) is BOOK data, territory for the curated tier, not fetchable from any living provider. The OWID door of the same GHE root (death-rate-from-suicides-ghe, both-sexes, 2000-2021) was probed and deliberately NOT wired in v13 — one witness door is the minimal honest choice; it remains the natural second door, exactly like the unwired GHO maternal doors recorded in v12.
